title: A MESSAGE FROM #PHILLIP THE #MARTYR
segments: my unwavering Devotion to spreading the
teachings of Christ I find myself in the
midst of a Time filled with turmoil and
persecution it was a time when our faith
was being tested and challenged by the
cruel forces of the world yet despite
the danger that loomed I remained
steadfast in my mission I journey to
distant lands carrying the message of
love hope and Redemption everywhere I
went it was during one of these missions
that I find myself paired with another
faithful Apostle Bartholomew as fate
would have it adversity struck our paths
and were both captured by a hostile
crowd who seeks to silence the voices of
Truth the minds of those who captured us
are clouded by Darkness intoxicated with
power and blinded by hatred we are
called to stand firm in the face of
adversity to carry the torch of faith
and To Boldly share the message of Our
Lord until the
end
